arrogant.linePrev: And now will you tell me why?"
arrogant.line: Well the young queen, she fixed him with an arrogant eye
arrogant.lineNext: She said, "You won't understand, and you may as well not try"
stanza: Well the young queen, she fixed him with an arrogant eye
She said, "You won't understand, and you may as well not try"
But her face was a child's and he thought she would cry
But she closed herself up like a fan
